subject: Procurement intake and vendor setup Nova Health
messages:
From: Dylan Brooks <dylan.brooks@redwoodinference.com>
To: Jane Park <jane.park@novahealth.com>, Procurement Ops <procurement@novahealth.com>
Cc: Marissa Cole <marissa.cole@redwoodinference.com>
Date: Mon, 5 Oct 2026 15:12:00 +0000
Subject: Intro + Procurement docs for Redwood Inference

Hi Jane / Procurement team —

Great speaking with you today. Quick recap from our discovery call with Nova Health:
- Use case: clinical documentation summarization for ambulatory clinics (pilot ~3 teams).
- Expected pilot spend: ~USD 3-5k over 30 days; production estimate depends on rollout.
- Key requirements called out: SOC2 logs, data residency in US, and vendor onboarding timeline.

Next steps on our side:
1) Share vendor setup packet, W-9, and bank info so you can open us in your vendor portal. (attached: redwood_vendor_packet_v1.pdf)
2) Confirm commercial path: do you prefer PO for pilot or are cards acceptable for initial pilots under $5k?
3) Are you looking for marketplace procurement (AWS Marketplace) or direct vendor setup?

I've CC'd Marissa (our vendor ops) — she'll coordinate the paperwork and any finance details.

Attachments: redwood_vendor_packet_v1.pdf (application/pdf, 120 KB)

Thanks — happy to jump on a quick call if helpful.

Cheers,
Dylan Brooks
Account Executive | Redwood Inference
dylan.brooks@redwoodinference.com | +1 (415) 555-0183
https://redwoodinference.com
From: Jane Park <jane.park@novahealth.com>
To: Dylan Brooks <dylan.brooks@redwoodinference.com>, Marissa Cole <marissa.cole@redwoodinference.com>
Date: Tue, 6 Oct 2026 09:23:00 -0700
Subject: Re: Intro + Procurement docs for Redwood Inference

Thanks, Dylan — appreciated the summary. A few questions from Procurement to help us triage: 

1) Vendor setup: please send a completed vendor setup form (we need legal name, DBA, tax ID, address, and banking instructions).
2) Commercial path: Nova Health typically uses PO for production contracts. For small pilots (< $5k) we can process via corporate card, but the procurement team prefers formal PO once we move to any multi-month engagement.
3) Marketplace: are you available via AWS Marketplace or other procurement marketplaces? If so, include marketplace seller IDs.
4) Required paperwork: we will need an executed W-9 (or W-8 if non-US), proof of banking (bank letter or voided check), and electronic vendor packet.

Please also include an estimated timeline for vendor setup once we receive completed docs.

Thanks — looped Samir (finance) for any bank verification questions.

Jane Park
Senior Procurement Manager | Nova Health
jane.park@novahealth.com | +1 (206) 555-0122

From: Marissa Cole <marissa.cole@redwoodinference.com>
To: Jane Park <jane.park@novahealth.com>
Cc: Dylan Brooks <dylan.brooks@redwoodinference.com>, Alex Martinez <alex.martinez@redwoodinference.com>
Date: Tue, 6 Oct 2026 14:45:00 -0700
Subject: Re: Intro + Procurement docs for Redwood Inference

Hi Jane — thanks for the clear list. I've attached the items you requested and outlined next steps below.

Attachments included:
- W-9.pdf (application/pdf, 45 KB)
- redwood_bank_letter.pdf (application/pdf, 28 KB)
- Completed vendor packet (DocuSign link below)

Answers / next steps:
• Commercial path: We support both PO and corporate card. For pilot <$5k card is fine; for production we expect a PO with standard net-30 terms (we can be flexible on payment terms if needed).
• Marketplace: Redwood Inference is currently listed on AWS Marketplace (Seller ID: AMI-REDWOOD-2026). If you prefer procurement via marketplace, we can provide the offer ID and help enable entitlement.
• Vendor setup timeline: once we receive the completed vendor packet and the W-9/bank letter, typical vendor portal verification takes 3-7 business days. If you need faster turnaround we can expedite with our finance team.
• Banking/ACH: attached bank letter includes routing + ACH instructions (we accept ACH credit; wire also supported). See redwood_bank_letter.pdf.

DocuSign vendor packet (fillable): https://docusign.com/12345-redwood-vendor-packet (signature request sent to procurement@novahealth.com)
HubSpot intake (for your reference): https://app.hubspot.com/contacts/1234567/contact/987654321

Alex (CC) handles contract/finance for enterprise customers — looping him in for any additional tax/contract questions.

If you can confirm the preferred commercial path (card vs PO) for the pilot and the email for the vendor portal invite, I'll mark the request as ready.

Best,
Marissa Cole
Vendor Operations Manager | Redwood Inference
marissa.cole@redwoodinference.com | +1 (650) 555-0199

From: Jane Park <jane.park@novahealth.com>
To: Marissa Cole <marissa.cole@redwoodinference.com>
Cc: Dylan Brooks <dylan.brooks@redwoodinference.com>, Samir Gupta <s.gupta@novahealth.com>
Date: Thu, 8 Oct 2026 11:05:00 -0700
Subject: Re: Intro + Procurement docs for Redwood Inference

Marissa — got everything, thanks. A couple quick follow-ups before we kick off the portal entry: 

• Bank details: can you confirm the ACH routing format (ACH credit vs ACH debit)? Our system prefers ACH credit.
• Tax ID: W-9 shows the EIN — confirmed.
• EDI: for volume billing, does Redwood support invoice EDI or would you prefer SFTP/email PDF invoices?

If you can reply to those three items we'll open the vendor record and estimate completion by next Wednesday (10/14).

Thanks — Jane
